concepts.learning_objective: Explain what disappeared when the Harappan 'First Urbanisation' disintegrated.
Describe when and where India's 'Second Urbanisation' began and how we know about it.
State the meaning of 'janapada' and how janapadas formed around clans.
Identify the sixteen mahajanapadas, their capitals and why many lay in the Ganga plains.
Describe the defensive features of mahajanapada capitals.
Explain the role of the sabha or samiti in advising and checking the raja.
Describe how monarchical mahajanapadas were ruled.
Explain why the ganas or sanghas such as Vajji and Malla are called early republics.
Explain how iron tools and weapons shaped the Second Urbanisation.
Describe the first Indian coins and why growing trade needed them.
Distinguish between jati and varna and identify the roles of the four varnas.
Explain how the varna-jati system was flexible earlier and became rigid over time.
Identify the Uttarapatha and Dakshinapatha and the role of roads in connecting regions.
Describe the rise of cities and kingdoms in eastern and southern India.
